descriptions.zh:
我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！

悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。
descriptions.en:
We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!

Grief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers of [Root.GetName] shell-shocked and disoriented. The clergy have decreed a half-decade of mourning.

descriptions.zh:
层层叠加的都市终于完全覆盖了星球的地表。

自从这一宏大计划开始实施以来仅仅过了数年，但已经很难回想起[Root.GetName]从前的面貌。翠绿的丛林？崎岖的山脉？现在放眼望去，四面八方都是延绵不绝的钢铁。

这里曾经由自然法则任意塑造，而现在则成了由坚定的目的锤炼而成的设计。
descriptions.en:
Layers upon layers of urban sprawl eclipse the globe's crust, and it is done.

Scant few years have passed since the start of this grand project, but it is already difficult to recall what the surface of [Root.GetName] was like. Verdant? Rugged? It is all steel now, miles in every direction.

A place once molded by chance and the unthinking laws of nature, now a design wrought from indomitable purpose.

descriptions.zh:
世世代代以来，[Root.GetName]上冰冷空寂的废墟始终蛰伏于此，静静诉说着千百万年前那陡然告终的黄金时代。

一切从此改变。这座覆盖整颗星球的城市重获新生，那些年久失修的废墟又一次充满了活力。凡是可以修复之处，现存的建筑和基础设施均已被修缮并重新规划用途。至于那些损坏太过严重的区域，其上的瓦砾和废墟也已清理干净，为建造新建筑腾出了空间。
descriptions.en:
For untold generations, the cold and empty ruins of [Root.GetName] have stood dormant, as quiet symbols of a golden age that came to an abrupt end eons ago.

No longer. The planet-wide city has at last been reborn, and those same dilapidated ruins are once more alive with activity. Where possible, existing buildings and infrastructure have been repaired and repurposed. Where the damage was too great, the rubble and ruins have been cleared away to allow for new construction.
